description.before: A classic pharmacokinetic model tracking drug concentration in plasma (central compartment) and tissues (peripheral compartment). Models ADME - Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Elimination. Used to design dosing regimens that maintain therapeutic drug levels while avoiding toxicity. Reference: Based on system dynamics methodology (Sterman, 2000; Forrester, 1961). Source: https://systemdynamics.org/
description.after: Illustrative Two-Compartment Pharmacokinetics Model. Source reconciliation 2026-10-20: The invalid book DOI was replaced by the publisher record of Gibaldi/Perrier (1982), a conceptual reference. The mechanistic equations were reconciled to the published Torsten two-compartment mass ODEs: Kel=CL/Vcentral, K12=Q/Vcentral, K21=Q/Vperipheral. Undeclared shorthand references now use existing stock names. An explicit non-systemic GI loss of Ka*GI*(1-F) makes GI depletion Ka*GI and systemic input F*Ka*GI, so F controls extent rather than only speed. Half Life now gives the slower disposition eigenmode, not ln(2)/Kel; if absorption is slower it need not equal the observed oral terminal half-life. Stocks are amounts (mg), volume L, time h, rates 1/h and concentration mg/L. Existing numerical constants and the 100 mg oral amount are illustrative, with no identified drug, fit or clinical therapeutic range; the existing therapeutic status diagnostic is not clinical advice. Scientific calibration and applicability remain unverified.

scope: Nine failing healthcare definitions. Only two-compartment PK equations reconciled; all other mathematical systems preserved and unresolved.

tests.reference: Independent closed-form eigenmode impulse-response convolution; F=0, .85 and1; full trajectory through24h; mass accounting; default Euler refinement;256h AUC; declared units and preserved existing IDs/labels/positions. Separate clone-only integrated sink test routes the actual unchanged Elimination and Non-systemic GI Loss flows into ephemeral cumulative stocks, verifies both sink trajectories against closed forms for F=0,.85,1 and whole-system mass at every timestep. Earlier closed-form dose accounting is an identity check, not evidence of actual integrated outflow topology.
tests.tolerances: RK4 dt=1/64h absolute amount error2e-6mg; initial dt=1/32h exceeded tolerance by about0.2e-6mg, corrected by refining timestep, not relaxing tolerance. Default Euler full-trajectory error <2mg; halving dt improves by >40%. AUC relative tolerance2e-4. Actual five-stock integrated mass conservation2e-11mg; each cumulative sink2e-6mg absolute.
